description: Department of Trade & Investment Policy - Special Commodity Levy Act No. 48 of 2007 Order under Sec 2
categorisation: This gazette content primarily involves the imposition and amendment of a Special Commodity Levy under the Special Commodity Levy Act, No. 48 of 2007. It contains regulatory changes to tax rates on specific commodities (rice and sugar), rescinds previous orders, and establishes new legal requirements. This fits the Legal/Regulatory classification (Type 5) as it deals with statutory instruments, regulatory frameworks, and compliance requirements rather than government personnel/structure or other specialized categories.
